title: Finalize Execution Intent Response
description: Response returned by POST /execution-intents/{businessTransactionId}/finalize. The finalize operation never calls a connector. It is safe to run more than once: FINALIZED means a Trust Record was rebuilt by this call, ALREADY_FINALIZED means one already existed and nothing was built.

trustRecordId.description: Identifier of the Execution Trust Record. Equal to trustRecord.trustRecordId.
